A self-report questionnaire, integrated with the Italian version of the Depression, Anxiety and Stress Scale–21 items (DASS-21) [ 15 ], and two scales (Negative Affect and Detachment) of the Personality Inventory for the Diagnostic and Statistical Manual of mental disorders, DSM-5–Brief Form (PID-5-BF) [ 11 ], was designed to measure psychological distress during the pandemic, aimed at establishing the prevalence of psychiatric symptoms and identifying risk and protective factors for psychological distress.
